# Shared repository instructions

Read and follow the repository root's `CLAUDE.md` before working here.
Read `docs/skills.md` to select a repository workflow. All workflows are
discoverable under `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`; the former holds the
authoritative procedures and resources, and the latter contains generated
adapters. Load the relevant `SKILL.md` and follow its source-security and
validation requirements. Keep workflow changes in the authoritative copy.
